entries.en: We must clear the decks before the inspection begins.
entries.zh: 检查开始前，我们必须扫清障碍、做好准备。

entries.en: Please clear the way for the ambulance.
entries.zh: 请给救护车让路。

entries.en: Keep a clean towel close at hand.
entries.zh: 把一条干净毛巾放在随手可取的地方。

entries.en: We rented a flat with a park close by.
entries.zh: 我们租了一套附近有公园的公寓。

entries.en: The lions began to close in for the kill.
entries.zh: 狮子开始缩小包围圈，准备捕杀猎物。

entries.en: The police began to close in on the hideout.
entries.zh: 警方开始逼近藏身处。

entries.en: The runners began to close on the leader.
entries.zh: 跑步选手开始接近领先者。

entries.en: The committee decided to close ranks against outside pressure.
entries.zh: 委员会决定团结起来抵御外部压力。

entries.en: We could club together to buy her a bicycle.
entries.zh: 我们可以凑钱给她买一辆自行车。

entries.meaningZh: 紧紧抓住；依附，cling 的过去式
entries.en: The child clung to his father's coat.
entries.zh: 孩子紧紧抓住父亲的外套。

entries.en: The two laboratories agreed to co-operate on the project.
entries.zh: 两家实验室同意合作开展这个项目。

entries.en: The pupils worked co-operatively to build a cardboard bridge.
entries.zh: 学生们合作搭建了一座纸板桥。

entries.en: Maya co-ordinated the deliveries with the warehouse team.
entries.zh: 玛雅与仓库团队协调了送货安排。

entries.meaningZh: 用颜色编码，colour-code 的过去式
entries.en: We colour-coded the cables to prevent wiring mistakes.
entries.zh: 我们用颜色给电缆编码，以免接线出错。

entries.en: The dog tried to come at me again.
entries.zh: 那条狗又想向我扑来。

entries.en: Do not let this argument come between you.
entries.zh: 别让这场争论影响你们的关系。

entries.en: The school will come down on anyone caught cheating.
entries.zh: 学校会严惩任何被发现作弊的人。

entries.en: The decision will come down to cost.
entries.zh: 这个决定最终取决于成本。

entries.en: I hope I do not come down with flu.
entries.zh: 我希望自己不要患上流感。

entries.en: I will come for the parcels tomorrow.
entries.zh: 我明天来取包裹。

entries.en: Several residents have come out against the proposed road.
entries.zh: 几位居民已经公开反对拟建的道路。

entries.en: The missing details will come out in the wash.
entries.zh: 那些缺失的细节最终会显露出来。

entries.en: Children sometimes come out with remarkably thoughtful questions.
entries.zh: 孩子们有时会提出极有见地的问题。

entries.en: They nearly came to blows over the parking space.
entries.zh: 他们差点为了那个停车位打起来。

entries.en: The wrestlers moved forward to come to grips with each other.
entries.zh: 摔跤手向前移动，准备相互扭打。

entries.en: She needed time to come to terms with her diagnosis.
entries.zh: 她需要时间逐渐接受自己的诊断结果。

entries.en: The proposal has come under intense public scrutiny.
entries.zh: 这项提议受到了公众的密切审视。

entries.en: Try not to come unglued when plans change.
entries.zh: 计划改变时，尽量不要慌乱失措。

entries.en: Even careful plans can come unstuck without enough funding.
entries.zh: 即使周密的计划也可能因资金不足而失败。

entries.en: You may come up against resistance from the committee.
entries.zh: 你可能会遭到委员会的抵制。

entries.en: We need to come up with a safer design.
entries.zh: 我们需要想出一种更安全的设计。

entries.en: Cold air was coming in through the broken window.
entries.zh: 冷空气正从破窗进入室内。

entries.en: Wear a helmet or you could cop it.
entries.zh: 戴上头盔，否则你可能会受伤。

entries.en: I did not cotton to our new neighbour immediately.
entries.zh: 我并没有立刻喜欢上我们的新邻居。

entries.en: A short employment gap should not count against you.
entries.zh: 一段短暂的就业空档不应成为对你不利的因素。

entries.en: Please count in the volunteers when ordering lunch.
entries.zh: 订午餐时请把志愿者也算进去。

entries.en: Count up the amounts on the receipts before completing the form.
entries.zh: 填表前先把收据上的金额加起来。

entries.en: Inspectors will crack down on factories dumping waste into rivers.
entries.zh: 检查人员将严厉查处向河流排放废物的工厂。

entries.en: We must crack on to reach camp before dark.
entries.zh: 我们必须继续赶路，在天黑前到达营地。

entries.en: The pilot had to crash-land in a field.
entries.zh: 飞行员不得不在一片田里迫降。

entries.en: The damaged plane was crash-landing on the beach.
entries.zh: 那架受损的飞机当时正在海滩上迫降。

entries.en: The rover crossed a heavily cratered plain.
entries.zh: 探测车穿过了一片坑洞密布的平原。

entries.en: These tight straps could crease up the fabric.
entries.zh: 这些绷紧的带子可能会把布料弄皱。

entries.en: Do not creep up on me like that.
entries.zh: 别那样悄悄靠近我。

entries.meaningZh: 悄悄爬行，creep 的过去式
entries.en: A small beetle crept under the door.
entries.zh: 一只小甲虫悄悄爬到了门下面。

entries.en: Careful cross-breeding produced sheep with thicker wool.
entries.zh: 精心进行的杂交育种培育出了羊毛更厚的绵羊。

entries.en: The exhibition explores cross-dressing in twentieth-century theatre.
entries.zh: 展览探讨了二十世纪戏剧中的异性服装装扮。

entries.en: Do not crowd in before the passengers leave.
entries.zh: 乘客下车之前不要挤进去。

entries.en: Do not crumple up the application form.
entries.zh: 不要把申请表揉皱。

entries.en: Both teams will cry foul if the rules change now.
entries.zh: 如果现在改变规则，两支队伍都会抗议不公平。

entries.en: The kittens cuddle up together to sleep beside the heater.
entries.zh: 小猫们在取暖器旁蜷缩在一起睡觉。

entries.en: He brought expensive gifts to curry favour with the manager.
entries.zh: 他送来昂贵的礼物，想讨好经理。

entries.en: We need to cut back on unnecessary travel.
entries.zh: 我们需要减少不必要的出行。

entries.en: I am trying to cut down on sugary drinks.
entries.zh: 我正在努力减少含糖饮料的摄入。

entries.en: Please do not cut in on our conversation.
entries.zh: 请不要打断我们的谈话。

entries.en: Enthusiasm alone will not cut it in this job.
entries.zh: 光有热情不足以胜任这份工作。

entries.en: This old printer no longer cuts the mustard.
entries.zh: 这台旧打印机已经不符合要求了。

entries.en: The chair tried to damp down the rising tension.
entries.zh: 主席试图缓和日益紧张的气氛。

entries.en: The answer began to dawn on me during lunch.
entries.zh: 吃午饭时，我开始逐渐明白答案了。

entries.en: The rescue teams worked day and night.
entries.zh: 救援队日夜不停地工作。

entries.en: Day trading involves buying and selling within one day.
entries.zh: 当日交易涉及在同一天内进行买卖。

entries.en: I walk beside the river to de-stress after work.
entries.zh: 下班后，我在河边散步来缓解压力。

entries.en: Remember to dead-head the roses after flowering.
entries.zh: 玫瑰花开败后，记得摘去枯花。

entries.en: We must deal with the leak immediately.
entries.zh: 我们必须立即处理漏水问题。

entries.en: The receptionist dealt with my enquiry politely.
entries.zh: 接待员礼貌地处理了我的咨询。

entries.en: We need to decide on a meeting place.
entries.zh: 我们需要选定一个见面地点。

entries.en: The army demobbed him after the war.
entries.zh: 战争结束后，军队安排他退伍。

entries.en: She shook her head deprecatingly at the extravagant proposal.
entries.zh: 面对这个铺张的提议，她不以为然地摇了摇头。

entries.en: Deseed the peppers before cutting them into strips.
entries.zh: 把甜椒切成条之前，先去掉籽。

entries.meaningZh: 使技能过时或不再需要
entries.en: New machinery can deskill jobs once performed by specialists.
entries.zh: 新机器可能使原本由专业人员完成的工作不再需要专业技能。

entries.en: We bought these sturdy chairs dirt-cheap at auction.
entries.zh: 我们在拍卖会上以极低的价格买到了这些结实的椅子。

entries.en: The police arrested two men for disturbing the peace.
entries.zh: 警方以扰乱治安为由逮捕了两名男子。

entries.en: The governor tried to divide and rule the rival groups.
entries.zh: 总督试图对相互竞争的群体实行分而治之。

entries.en: Let us divide up the tasks before starting.
entries.zh: 我们开始前先分配任务吧。

entries.en: Do not let dishonest traders do down inexperienced buyers.
entries.zh: 不要让不诚实的商人欺骗没有经验的买家。

entries.en: This box will do for a temporary table.
entries.zh: 这个箱子可以暂时充当桌子。

entries.en: These photographs do not do justice to the landscape.
entries.zh: 这些照片没能充分展现这片风景的美。

entries.en: The young trees are doing nicely in their new pots.
entries.zh: 这些小树在新花盆里长势良好。

entries.en: We must do out the spare room before Friday.
entries.zh: 我们必须在星期五之前把空房间打扫好。

entries.en: We will have to do over the whole experiment.
entries.zh: 我们将不得不把整个实验重新做一遍。

entries.en: We can do without a car this weekend.
entries.zh: 这个周末没有汽车，我们也能应付。

entries.meaningZh: 做，do 的第三人称单数形式
entries.en: He does the washing after breakfast every day.
entries.zh: 他每天早饭后洗衣服。

entries.meaningZh: 打扮得漂亮，doll up 的过去分词
entries.en: She had dolled up for her older sister's wedding.
entries.zh: 她为了姐姐的婚礼精心打扮了一番。

entries.en: The volunteers went door to door distributing leaflets.
entries.zh: 志愿者挨家挨户分发传单。

entries.meaningZh: 做，do 的古体第三人称单数形式
entries.en: She doth perform her duties with remarkable care.
entries.zh: 她履行职责时格外认真。

entries.en: Double-click the folder to open its contents.
entries.zh: 双击这个文件夹以查看其中的内容。

entries.meaningZh: 给窗户装双层玻璃，double-glaze 的过去式
entries.en: The contractor double-glazed every window in the house.
entries.zh: 承包商给房子里的每扇窗户都装了双层玻璃。

entries.en: The workers threatened to down tools over unpaid wages.
entries.zh: 工人们威胁要因工资被拖欠而停工。

entries.en: The empty boat drifted down-river during the night.
entries.zh: 那艘空船在夜里漂向了下游。

entries.en: Downshifting before the bend helped him control the car.
entries.zh: 在弯道前换低挡帮助他控制了汽车。

entries.en: She drank a glass of water before leaving.
entries.zh: 她离开前喝了一杯水。

entries.en: We must draw a line between evidence and speculation.
entries.zh: 我们必须把证据和猜测区分开。

entries.en: She preferred to draw a veil over that unhappy year.
entries.zh: 她宁愿不再谈起那不愉快的一年。

entries.en: He paused to draw breath before the next verse.
entries.zh: 唱下一段之前，他停下来吸了口气。

entries.en: The decision is likely to draw fire from parents.
entries.zh: 这个决定很可能招致家长的批评。

entries.en: We will draw lots to decide who goes first.
entries.zh: 我们将抽签决定谁先开始。

entries.en: You can draw on your experience as a teacher.
entries.zh: 你可以利用自己当老师的经验。

entries.meaningZh: 把……定为不可逾越的界限
entries.en: I draw the line at working every weekend.
entries.zh: 我不能接受每个周末都工作。

entries.en: Dream on if you expect a private helicopter.
entries.zh: 如果你指望能有一架私人直升机，那就是痴心妄想。

entries.en: I dreamt about our old house last night.
entries.zh: 我昨晚梦到了我们以前的房子。

entries.en: Let us drink to your safe return.
entries.zh: 让我们为你平安归来干杯。

entries.meaningZh: 通过导管缓慢输送流质食物
entries.en: The team used a tube to drip-feed the patient.
entries.zh: 医护团队用导管缓慢地给病人输送流质食物。

entries.meaningZh: 讨价还价，争取有利条件
entries.en: Our supplier knows how to drive a hard bargain.
entries.zh: 我们的供应商很会讨价还价。

entries.en: We could drop in on Lena after lunch.
entries.zh: 午饭后，我们可以顺道拜访莉娜。

entries.en: Please drop it; the matter has been settled.
entries.zh: 别再提了，事情已经解决了。

entries.en: Dry off before putting on your clean clothes.
entries.zh: 穿上干净衣服前，先把身上擦干。

entries.en: You should dry-clean this coat rather than wash it.
entries.zh: 这件外套应该干洗，而不是水洗。

entries.en: The shop is dry-cleaning my curtains this week.
entries.zh: 这家店这个星期正在为我干洗窗帘。

entries.en: You cannot duck out whenever the work becomes difficult.
entries.zh: 不能工作一变难，你就溜走。

entries.en: Do not dumb down the explanation for our audience.
entries.zh: 不要为我们的听众把解释过度简化。

entries.en: I need to dust off my French before travelling.
entries.zh: 旅行前，我需要重温一下法语。

entries.en: Her family dwelt beside the river for generations.
entries.zh: 她家几代人都住在河边。

entries.en: He had to eat humble pie and apologise.
entries.zh: 他不得不忍辱认错，作出道歉。

entries.en: We have eaten all the bread already.
entries.zh: 我们已经把面包都吃完了。

entries.en: The novel captures the ebb and flow of family life.
entries.zh: 这部小说描绘了家庭生活的起伏。

entries.en: The newcomer could edge out the defending champion.
entries.zh: 这位新选手可能会险胜卫冕冠军。

entries.en: We can meet indoors or outside; either way, I will be there.
entries.zh: 我们可以在室内或外面见面，不论哪种情况，我都会到场。

entries.en: They eke out an existence selling vegetables beside the road.
entries.zh: 他们靠在路边卖蔬菜勉强糊口。

entries.meaningZh: 使电气化，electrify 的过去式
entries.en: The railway company electrified this line last year.
entries.zh: 铁路公司去年完成了这条线路的电气化改造。

entries.en: All six guest bedrooms have bathrooms en suite.
entries.zh: 六间客房都配有独立卫浴。

entries.meaningZh: 涂上瓷漆，enamel 的过去式
entries.en: She enamelled the metal box a bright blue.
entries.zh: 她给金属盒涂上了鲜蓝色瓷漆。

entries.en: The craftworker is enamelling a set of copper bowls.
entries.zh: 工匠正在给一套铜碗上釉。

entries.en: Both firms agreed to enter into a partnership.
entries.zh: 两家公司同意建立合作关系。

entries.en: We equipped the laboratory with new safety cabinets.
entries.zh: 我们为实验室配备了新的安全柜。

entries.en: We left early, but even then we missed the bus.
entries.zh: 我们很早就出发了，但即使这样，还是没赶上公交车。

entries.en: Every now and again, a deer visits our garden.
entries.zh: 偶尔会有一只鹿来到我们的花园。

entries.en: We eat outside every once in a while.
entries.zh: 我们偶尔在外面吃饭。

entries.en: Could you expand on your final point?
entries.zh: 你能详细说明最后一点吗？

entries.en: She could not explain away the missing receipts.
entries.zh: 她无法通过解释打消大家对收据丢失的疑虑。

entries.en: The two negotiators sat eyeball to eyeball.
entries.zh: 两位谈判代表面对面地坐着。

entries.en: We must face down the threat without using violence.
entries.zh: 我们必须不用暴力就挫败这一威胁。

entries.en: You need to face up to your responsibilities.
entries.zh: 你需要勇敢承担自己的责任。

entries.en: Stop faffing about and put your shoes on.
entries.zh: 别瞎忙了，把鞋穿上。

entries.en: They won the final fair and square.
entries.zh: 他们光明正大地赢得了决赛。

entries.en: His ridiculous costume made everyone fall about laughing.
entries.zh: 他那身滑稽的服装让大家忍不住大笑。

entries.en: Keep some savings to fall back on in emergencies.
entries.zh: 留一些积蓄，以备紧急时依靠。

entries.en: Several passengers began to fall ill during the voyage.
entries.zh: 几名乘客在航行期间开始生病。

entries.en: It is easy to fall in love with this city.
entries.zh: 很容易就会爱上这座城市。

entries.en: I cannot fall in with a plan this risky.
entries.zh: 我不能同意这么冒险的计划。

entries.en: The wolves were ready to fall on their prey.
entries.zh: 狼群准备扑向猎物。

entries.en: The guests began to fall to with enthusiasm.
entries.zh: 客人们开始兴致勃勃地吃起来。

entries.en: This old chair could fall to pieces at any moment.
entries.zh: 这把旧椅子随时可能散架。

entries.en: The journey was far from easy in that weather.
entries.zh: 在那样的天气下，这段旅程绝不轻松。

entries.en: You can fast forward the tape to the next song.
entries.zh: 你可以把磁带快进到下一首歌。

entries.en: They feed up the calves before the winter.
entries.zh: 他们在冬天来临前把小牛喂壮。

entries.en: We should fence off the pond for safety.
entries.zh: 为了安全，我们应该用篱笆把池塘围起来。

entries.en: New assistants should not merely fetch and carry all day.
entries.zh: 新助理不应该整天只是打杂。

entries.en: Do not fiddle about while everyone else is waiting.
entries.zh: 大家都在等着，不要再瞎忙了。

entries.en: We cannot fiddle around for the entire afternoon.
entries.zh: 我们不能整个下午都无所事事。

entries.en: They must fight out their differences in the courtroom.
entries.zh: 他们必须在法庭上通过争辩解决分歧。

entries.en: Small firms often fight shy of expensive advertising.
entries.zh: 小公司往往不愿采用昂贵的广告宣传。

entries.en: We will fight tooth and nail to save the library.
entries.zh: 我们将竭尽全力争取保住这座图书馆。

entries.en: Do not figure on getting a seat without booking.
entries.zh: 不要指望不预订就能有座位。

entries.en: Please figure up our expenses for the week.
entries.zh: 请把我们这一周的开销加起来。

entries.en: He can find fault with even the best work.
entries.zh: 即使是最好的作品，他也能挑出毛病。

entries.en: The engineers are fine-tuning the control system.
entries.zh: 工程师们正在微调控制系统。

entries.en: Tell me when you finish with the scissors.
entries.zh: 你用完剪刀后告诉我。

entries.en: If you have any questions, fire away.
entries.zh: 如果你有问题，就尽管问吧。

entries.en: Reporters began to fire off questions at the minister.
entries.zh: 记者们开始接连向部长发问。

entries.en: First and foremost, we must protect the children.
entries.zh: 最重要的是，我们必须保护孩子们。

entries.en: I will check the boiler first thing tomorrow.
entries.zh: 我明天一大早就检查锅炉。

entries.en: Can you fish out the keys from my bag?
entries.zh: 你能从我的包里摸出钥匙吗？

entries.en: The cabinet will fit into this narrow space.
entries.zh: 这个柜子能放进这处狭窄的空间。

entries.en: They will fit up the room as a workshop.
entries.zh: 他们将把这个房间装备成工作室。

entries.en: We need to fix on a date soon.
entries.zh: 我们需要尽快选定一个日期。

entries.en: The thieves fled before the police arrived.
entries.zh: 小偷们在警察到来前逃走了。

entries.en: A small bird flew through the open window.
entries.zh: 一只小鸟从敞开的窗户飞了进来。

entries.en: Several rumours continue to float around the office.
entries.zh: 办公室里仍在流传着好几个传言。

entries.en: She has flown across the Atlantic many times.
entries.zh: 她曾多次乘飞机飞越大西洋。

entries.en: He flung his muddy boots into the corner.
entries.zh: 他把沾满泥的靴子猛地扔进角落。

entries.en: Flush out the pipe with plenty of clean water.
entries.zh: 用大量清水把管道冲洗干净。

entries.en: The bird might fly at anyone approaching its nest.
entries.zh: 那只鸟可能会扑向任何靠近鸟巢的人。

entries.en: He tends to fly into a rage over small delays.
entries.zh: 遇到一点小小的延误，他就容易勃然大怒。

entries.en: They tried to foist on us an unwanted subscription.
entries.zh: 他们试图把我们不想要的订阅强加给我们。

entries.en: Fold in the flour with a large spoon.
entries.zh: 用大勺把面粉轻轻拌入。

entries.en: Do not fool about near the railway tracks.
entries.zh: 不要在铁轨附近胡闹。

entries.en: I know for a fact that he was there.
entries.zh: 我确切地知道他当时在那里。

entries.en: For a start, the roof needs urgent repairs.
entries.zh: 首先，屋顶急需维修。

entries.en: I said it for fun, not to upset you.
entries.zh: 我是开玩笑说的，不是想让你难过。

entries.en: I thought she was joking, but her offer was for real.
entries.zh: 我以为她在开玩笑，但她的提议是认真的。

entries.en: For some reason, the printer refuses to start.
entries.zh: 不知为什么，打印机就是启动不了。

entries.en: For starters, we should agree on a budget.
entries.zh: 首先，我们应该商定预算。

entries.en: The notice forbade parking beside the entrance.
entries.zh: 告示禁止在入口旁停车。

entries.en: She forgave him for forgetting her birthday.
entries.zh: 她原谅了他忘记自己生日的事。

entries.en: Despite the setback, we must forge ahead with construction.
entries.zh: 尽管遭遇挫折，我们仍必须继续推进施工。

entries.en: I forgot to bring my glasses today.
entries.zh: 我今天忘带眼镜了。

entries.en: He forwent a holiday to pay the repair bill.
entries.zh: 他为了支付维修费而放弃了休假。

entries.en: The brothers fought over the last piece of cake.
entries.zh: 兄弟俩为了最后一块蛋糕打了起来。
